items.detail: runs/45..49/verification.json and runs/45..49/integration-verification.json add ~310 lines of bookkeeping no criterion asked for. They pollute the PR diff and will conflict on every subsequent epic that reuses the same run ids. They belong in .gitignore.

items.title: src/format.js has zero non-test callers and no test
items.detail: An exported function reachable from nothing, and the smoke suite does not exercise it either, so no gate would notice if it broke or if the follow-up ticket never lands. This is the control-wired-to-nothing pattern: typecheck, lint and tests all pass over dead code.

items.title: The dispatcher's error branch is untested
items.detail: src/cli.js holds the only conditional logic in the diff (unknown command and no-argument both exit 1 with a usage line on stderr) and README documents that contract, but criterion 47.5 required the smoke suite to skip cli.js entirely. Nothing in the repo guards the behaviour the README promises.

summary: Added four tests to test/smoke.test.mjs covering src/cli.js's no-argument and unknown-command paths (exit 1, empty stdout, exact usage line on stderr), a positive dispatch case, and both branches of src/format.js. Committed as dba6ee6. Left the runs/ artifacts in place because main already tracks runs/001..006 with logs, prompts and reports, making committed runner output this repo's existing convention rather than something this branch introduced. Left src/format.js in place because deleting an accepted, passed deliverable is a human decision, but confirmed no follow-up ticket wires it in and that its own comment claiming one does is false. Checks: node src/greet.js exits 0, node --test test/smoke.test.mjs passes 10/10.

fixed.title: Add a test covering src/cli.js's unknown-command and no-argument paths; the README documents a contract nothing verifies.
fixed.detail: Added tests asserting src/cli.js exits 1 with empty stdout and the exact README usage line on stderr for both no-argument and unknown-command invocations, plus a positive case asserting a known command dispatches and prints. The README contract is now verified.

fixed.title: src/format.js has zero non-test callers and no test
fixed.detail: Added a unit test importing format from src/format.js and asserting both branches (passthrough with no opts, with empty opts, and JSON wrapping when opts.json is set). The function is no longer reachable from nothing by any gate; a breakage would now fail the suite. The zero-caller half is deferred as F2.

fixed.title: The dispatcher's error branch is untested
fixed.detail: Same tests as F3 — the dispatcher's error branch is now exercised by the smoke suite, closing the gap criterion 47.5 left when it excluded cli.js.
